title: Empirical Analysis of Citation Frequencies in LLM-Generated Web Answers
author: Nelson F. Liu
content:
--- Page 1 ---
1. Introduction and Problem Formulation
Large language models deployed in web-search interfaces increasingly synthesize answers directly from retrieved documents. However, only 51.5% of generated sentences in search-oriented LLM outputs are fully supported by citations.

--- Page 2 ---
2. Citation Grounding and Hallucination Rates
Our evaluation across 1,000 diverse benchmark queries indicates that 34.2% of provided citations fail to support the sentence they are attached to, highlighting a substantial grounding gap in current generative search implementations.
